# LinearProgressVariant

`Flare.Components.LinearProgressVariant`

Which of the linear track's three shapes FlareProgressLinear draws.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Bar` | `0` | A single active indicator on a track: the ordinary progress bar. |
| `Buffer` | `1` | The bar plus a muted secondary fill behind it, for buffered-ahead work. |
| `Query` | `2` | A pulse sweeping backwards along the track, for work whose size is not known yet. |

## Used by components

- `FlareProgressLinear`
